Definition: of Hebrew origin (H5321); Nephthaleim (i.e. Naphthali), a tribe in Palestine:--Nephthalim.
BiblicalUsage: Nephthalim is the Greek form of Naphtali, the tribe descended from Jacob's sixth son. Jesus leaves Nazareth and settles in Capernaum on the borders of Zebulun and Nephthalim, so that the light dawns first in the very land Isaiah named, and the tribe's name is still there at the end, sealed among the twelve tribes.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God keeps His promises tribe by tribe and name by name — the land that heard the prophecy is the land where Christ begins, and Nephthalim is not forgotten in the sealing.
